versions.line: A command Claude Code blocked now always shows Allow beside Don't allow on its card
Rewinding a chat in the Claude app no longer empties its panel
A file Claude sends you or a report names now opens when you click it
The moving rings on a card's helpers and commands keep turning smoothly as rows come and go around them
Text you pasted into a message shows in its quote as your words, without the marks around it
A task's card shows the pages, pictures and documents its result names
The chat no longer ends its replies with a line about which cards wait for you
A coloured reply quotes the message of yours it answers
Each coloured reply quotes, in small letters under the task's name, what you wrote to start that task
The box above the chat for a task takes that task's colour
Reply on a coloured reply opens the box above the chat for that task
The boxes for every area are back under the Progress chart
Memory moved from the top of the panel into Config, under You
Config has Task colours, off unless you turn it on
The Progress chart is now the areas themselves
Each month of the Progress chart now shows what you worked on that month, not today's goals
The Progress chart shows one month at a time, with a press to earlier months back to your first results
Progress now also sorts your chats from before Claudopus came in, read from their saved words
While your past results are still being sorted into areas, the Progress tab says how far it has got
Claudopus now sorts each task into an area of your work in the background
Stats and the leaderboard now count your work when Claude Code keeps its files somewhere other than…
Tasks and their helpers keep their prompt cache for an hour, as the chat does, instead of 5 minutes
The Stats tab counts each task's helpers, and their helpers, as Claudes of their own
Claudopus installs with one line in Terminal
A task that asks you one question after another keeps every one on its card, each with its own buttons
The chat passes on a task's result as it did before 0.2.274
A task that ends its step while a command you allowed runs (such as a release Claude Code blocked) now…
Each reply in a task's chat, and its result, has a Copy button that copies the whole text
Each card of the bar above the prompt now has a small chart of that figure's last 10 minutes
Typing "allow", "yes", "release it" or a button's own words in the chat now answers the card that waits…
